title: Islam ko bacha gayi
body:
islam ko bacha gayi kulsoom fatema
zainab ke saath saath thi kulsoom fatema
<<DIVIDER>>
aansu qalam ki nok par gham sheh ka rote hai
nok e sina pe dekhi thi kulsoom fatema
zainab ke saath saath...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo sansanata teer wo baysheer ka gala
dekhi behan ka haal bhi kulsoom fatema
zainab ke saath saath...
<<DIVIDER>>
akbar ke baad baithi na saaye mein phir kabhi
laila kaleja thaam li kulsoom fatema
zainab ke saath saath...
<<DIVIDER>>
pamaal gulbadan hua bhai ke saamne
bewa ko saath le gayi kulsoom fatema
zainab ke saath saath...
<<DIVIDER>>
maqtal ho ya ke kufa ho zindan e shaam mein
shabbir ki behan wo thi kulsoom fatema
zainab ke saath saath...
<<DIVIDER>>
allah jaane kaise saha hai rabaab ne
asghar ke gham mein mar gayi kulsoom fatema
zainab ke saath saath...
<<DIVIDER>>
nana ka baba jaan ka bhai ka gham liye
poocho kahan kahan gayi kulsoom fatema
zainab ke saath saath...
<<DIVIDER>>
sar par wo khaak udaati hai iqbal aandhiyan
saber duhaai deti hai kulsoom fatema
zainab ke saath saath...
author: Iqbal Abedi
